risk_presets.label: Locked Down
risk_presets.help: Tightest defaults. Workspace-only filesystem access, approval required for medium and high risk, no shell environment passthrough.

risk_presets.label: Balanced
risk_presets.help: Trusted daily driver for a personal dev box. Supervised, workspace-scoped with sensitive paths blocked and the sandbox on. Any command runs without an allowlist, but high-risk commands stay blocked unless explicitly allowlisted. Recommended for most users.

risk_presets.label: YOLO
risk_presets.help: Full autonomy. No approval gates, no command denylist, no workspace scoping. Only pick this if you know what you're doing on a machine you don't mind breaking.

runtime_presets.label: Tight
runtime_presets.help: Small budgets and short timeouts. Good for cheap models, metered API keys, or tight feedback loops where you want the agent to stop and ask early rather than burn budget.

runtime_presets.label: Local Small
runtime_presets.help: Compact no-text-fallback profile for smaller local models. Keeps context and tool results small, disables parallel tool fan-out, and requires native or structured tool calls.

runtime_presets.label: Balanced
runtime_presets.help: Middle-of-the-road operational defaults. Suits most users most of the time.

runtime_presets.label: Unbounded
runtime_presets.help: Wide-open budgets and long timeouts. Pick this when you're actively driving the agent through a hard task and don't want it to throttle.
